decisions.reason: As a core garage-door-operator line launched with its own webpage, it carries visible sunk investment and public commitment, so management would be inclined to keep backing it unless there were clear persistent failures.

Although this operator variant is less prominently positioned and partly overlaps with the broader operator range, it still fits the firm's core offer and escalation of commitment makes withdrawal less likely than continued support.

This glazed industrial sectional door remains close to the firm's industrial access competence, and prior development and market introduction efforts support a decision to continue rather than retreat quickly.

The insulated glazed industrial door matches the firm's quality, compliance and performance positioning, so management is likely to interpret any weaker results as manageable and keep it on the market.
Because it was given a dedicated webpage and sits squarely within the firm's announced industrial door direction, management would be especially reluctant to reverse course and would keep it.
